description: End-to-end workflow for planning, assessing, scheduling, approving, executing, and auditing telco network changes within a centralized change calendar.

change_id.description: Unique identifier for a planned or in-progress network change.

maintenance_window_id.description: Identifier for a reserved maintenance window in the change calendar.

impact_assessment_id.description: Identifier for a specific impact assessment run against a change.

rollback_plan_id.description: Identifier for a stored rollback plan template or instance.

approval_workflow_id.description: Identifier for the approval workflow instance associated with a change.

environment.description: Network environment targeted by the change.

risk_level.description: Overall risk classification for the change.

device_target.description: Network element or group targeted by the change.

id.description: Identifier of the target (device ID, group ID, service ID, or site ID).

actor_ref.description: Reference to the actor (human user or system) performing an action.

attachment_ref.description: Attachment reference: file or external link.

tag_filter.description: Tag-based filter with key/value match and operators.

functions.name: propose_change_request
functions.description: Create a draft change request with high-level details and initial targeting.

title.description: Short human-readable title of the change.

description.description: Detailed description of the planned change.

requested_by.description: User or system ID of the requester.

targets.description: List of devices, services, or sites impacted by this change.

proposed_window.description: Initial proposed start and end time for the change.

flexibility.description: Indicates how much the window can shift.

earliest_start_offset_minutes.description: How many minutes earlier the start may begin.

latest_end_offset_minutes.description: How many minutes later the end may finish.

expected_impact.description: Structured description of service and customer impact.

change_plan.description: High-level implementation plan, broken into steps.

automation_runbook_id.description: Optional ID linking to an automation or script.

validation_checks.description: Pre/post checks to validate network health.

kpi_thresholds.description: Map of KPI names to acceptable thresholds.

custom_fields.description: Arbitrary additional metadata, schema varies by deployment.

functions.returns: Newly created change request with assigned change_id and initial status 'draft'.

functions.name: assess_change_impact
functions.description: Run an automated impact and risk assessment for a proposed change.

change_id.description: Identifier of the change to assess.

depth.description: Granularity and runtime of impact assessment.

include_redundancy_analysis.description: Whether to analyze redundancy and failover paths.

what_if_scenarios.description: Optional what-if variations of this change.

functions.returns: Impact assessment result with impact_assessment_id, updated risk_level, and summary of affected services and redundancy posture.

functions.name: search_change_calendar_slots
functions.description: Search for available or optimal maintenance windows in the change calendar.

time_range.description: Overall time range within which the window must fall.

duration_minutes.description: Required duration of the maintenance window.

targets.description: Targets whose existing changes and blackout periods must be considered.

preferred_start_times.description: Preferred start times (HH:MM, 24h) in local timezone.

max_parallel_changes_per_target.description: Cap on concurrent changes for a given target.

functions.returns: List of recommended maintenance windows with provisional maintenance_window_id candidates and conflict summaries.

functions.name: reserve_maintenance_window
functions.description: Reserve a specific maintenance window for a change, performing conflict checks and tentative holds.

requested_window.description: Exact window to reserve if available.

reservation_mode.description: Whether the reservation is tentative (soft hold) or firm (blocks others).

auto_shift_if_conflict.description: Whether to automatically move to nearest conflict-free window.

max_auto_shift_minutes.description: Maximum shift allowed when auto shifting.

functions.returns: Reservation result with maintenance_window_id, final reserved time, and any conflict notes.

functions.name: configure_rollback_plan
functions.description: Attach or define a rollback plan for a given change.

base_plan.description: Existing rollback plan to clone and adapt, if any.

override_parameters.description: Key-value overrides for the base plan parameters.

steps.description: If no base_plan is used, explicit rollback steps can be defined.

triggers.description: Conditions under which rollback should be initiated.

manual_rollback_allowed.description: Whether operators can manually trigger rollback regardless of metrics.

functions.returns: Configured rollback plan with rollback_plan_id linked to the change.

functions.name: submit_change_for_approval
functions.description: Submit a planned change into the approval workflow, collecting required approvers and policy checks.

approval_policy.description: Overrides or selection of approval policy.

override_reason.description: Reason for overriding default policy, if applicable.

requested_approvers.description: Optional explicit list of approvers or groups.

required.description: If true, this approver must respond.

attachments.description: Supporting documents, e.g., network diagrams or test reports.

functions.returns: Approval workflow instance with approval_workflow_id, current approval status, and list of approvers.

functions.name: update_change_approval_status
functions.description: Record an approval decision for a change from an approver or automation policy.

delegated_to.description: If decision is 'delegate', indicates new approver.

risk_override.description: Optional override of risk_level when approving.

functions.returns: Updated approval workflow state, including overall approval outcome and any remaining pending approvers.

functions.name: execute_change
functions.description: Trigger and track the execution of an approved change during its maintenance window.

execution_mode.description: Indicates the level of automation for execution.

pre_checks_results.description: Optional pre-change validation results if run externally.

dry_run.description: If true, simulate execution without applying changes where supported.

functions.returns: Execution job details including current change_status, execution logs reference, and monitoring hooks.

functions.name: monitor_change_execution
functions.description: Retrieve real-time or recent status, metrics, and anomalies for an executing or recently completed change.

relative_minutes.description: If provided, ignore from/to and use this many minutes back from now.

metrics_filter.description: Filter metrics by service, region, or threshold breaches.

functions.returns: Snapshot of execution status, including change_status, KPI trends, anomalies, and any active rollback triggers.

functions.name: trigger_rollback
functions.description: Manually or automatically trigger rollback for a change and track rollback execution.

rollback_plan_id.description: If omitted, the default rollback plan associated with the change is used.

rollback_scope_override.description: Optionally restrict rollback to a subset of targets.

force.description: If true, bypass certain safety checks (for emergencies).

functions.returns: Rollback job details including new change_status, rollback execution log reference, and outcome summary.

functions.name: get_change_details
functions.description: Retrieve full details for a specific change, including status, schedule, approvals, and history.

mask_sensitive_fields.description: If true, redact sensitive fields like credentials or internal notes.

functions.returns: Complete change record with current change_status, schedule, targets, risk, approvals, and optional historical data.

functions.name: list_changes
functions.description: List and filter changes across the change calendar with pagination and sorting.

time_range.description: Filter by scheduled start or end within this range.

targets.description: Match changes affecting any of these targets.

include_counts.description: If true, include total matching count for pagination.

functions.returns: Paginated list of changes matching the filters, with optional total count and aggregation summaries.

functions.name: retry_or_reschedule_change
functions.description: Retry execution of a failed change or reschedule a planned change, with optional partial retries.

failure_context.description: Optional context about why the previous attempt failed.

new_window.description: If action is 'retry_in_new_window' or 'reschedule_only', define a new window or constraints.

use_calendar_search.description: If true, system will find an optimal window based on calendar constraints.

search_constraints.description: Constraints similar to search_change_calendar_slots, reused when use_calendar_search is true.

partial_retry_scope.description: Optional subset of targets to include in this retry.

functions.returns: Updated change schedule and status, with any new maintenance_window_id and retry execution plan summary.

functions.name: cancel_change
functions.description: Cancel a planned or in-progress change, releasing its maintenance window and updating audit trail.

cancellation_mode.description: Indicates whether the change is being canceled before or during execution, and how aggressively.

requested_by.description: User or system ID requesting cancellation.

release_window.description: If true, configured maintenance_window_id will be released back to the calendar.

functions.returns: Cancellation confirmation with final change_status, released maintenance_window_id (if any), and notification summary.

functions.name: search_change_calendar_entities
functions.description: Faceted search across change_calendar entities supporting tag filters, time windows, full-text, status, and pagination.

projection.description: Optional list of fields to project in the response.

functions.returns: Paginated list of matching change_calendar entities, optional facet counts, and pagination cursors.

functions.name: bulk_create_change_calendar_records
functions.description: Bulk-create up to N change_calendar records in a single atomic-or-best-effort batch with per-item validation results.
functions.returns: Per-record outcome with assigned ids or validation errors, plus an overall batch summary.

functions.name: bulk_update_change_calendar_records
functions.description: Apply a partial update patch to many change_calendar records, optionally with optimistic concurrency checks.
functions.returns: Per-update result with new version ids and a count of successes/failures.

functions.name: bulk_delete_change_calendar_records
functions.description: Delete or soft-delete many change_calendar records in one call, with cascade and dry-run options.
functions.returns: Per-id deletion outcome and references to any cascaded entities.

functions.name: export_change_calendar_dataset
functions.description: Schedule or stream an export of change_calendar data to CSV/JSONL/Parquet, with field selection and filters.
functions.returns: Export job id, estimated row count, and status tracking endpoint.

functions.name: import_change_calendar_dataset
functions.description: Validate and import a change_calendar dataset from a remote URI; supports dry-run and conflict handling.

mapping.description: Source column to target field mapping.

functions.returns: Import job id, row counts (succeeded/failed/skipped), and a sample of validation errors.

functions.name: snapshot_change_calendar_state
functions.description: Create a point-in-time snapshot of one or more change_calendar entities for later restore or comparison.
functions.returns: Snapshot id, size estimate, and retention expiry timestamp.

functions.name: restore_change_calendar_snapshot
functions.description: Restore change_calendar state from a prior snapshot with dry-run preview and conflict resolution.
functions.returns: Restore plan or actual restore result with per-entity status.

functions.name: get_change_calendar_metrics
functions.description: Query aggregated metrics/KPIs for the change_calendar workflow with grouping, filters, and time ranges.
functions.returns: Time-series points per metric and group, with totals and percentiles.

functions.name: build_change_calendar_dashboard
functions.description: Compose a dashboard view across change_calendar metrics, with panels, filters, and a shareable link.
functions.returns: Dashboard id, share URL, and resolved layout metadata.

functions.name: query_change_calendar_audit_events
functions.description: Search the change_calendar audit/change log with filters across actors, actions, resources, and time windows.
functions.returns: Paginated audit events with optional before/after diffs.

functions.name: subscribe_change_calendar_events
functions.description: Create a webhook subscription that delivers change_calendar workflow events to a target URL with retries and signing.
functions.returns: Subscription id, verification challenge if applicable, and active flag.

functions.name: list_change_calendar_subscriptions
functions.description: List webhook subscriptions for change_calendar events with filters and status counts.
functions.returns: Paginated list of subscriptions with last delivery status.

functions.name: delete_change_calendar_subscription
functions.description: Remove a webhook subscription for change_calendar events.
functions.returns: Confirmation with final delivery counters.

functions.name: schedule_change_calendar_job
functions.description: Schedule a recurring or one-off change_calendar job (cron/rrule/interval) with arguments and an owner.
functions.returns: Schedule id and next computed run time.

functions.name: list_change_calendar_schedules
functions.description: List scheduled change_calendar jobs with filters and pagination.
functions.returns: Paginated list of schedules with last/next run timestamps.

functions.name: cancel_change_calendar_schedule
functions.description: Cancel or pause a scheduled change_calendar job.
functions.returns: Updated schedule state.

functions.name: simulate_change_calendar_operation
functions.description: Run a what-if simulation of a change_calendar operation without committing side effects, returning predicted outcomes.
functions.returns: Predicted outcomes, side-effect summary, warnings, and policy hits.

functions.name: request_change_calendar_approval
functions.description: Open an approval request for a change_calendar action, routing to the right approvers and policies.
functions.returns: Approval request id, routed approver list, and SLA timer.

functions.name: decide_change_calendar_approval
functions.description: Record an approve/reject/abstain decision on a change_calendar approval request with required justification.
functions.returns: Updated approval state and downstream effects (e.g., gate releases).

functions.name: add_change_calendar_comment
functions.description: Add a threaded comment or annotation to any change_calendar entity, supporting mentions and attachments.
functions.returns: Comment id, thread id, and updated thread state.

functions.name: list_change_calendar_comments
functions.description: List comments/annotations attached to a change_calendar entity with pagination and filters.
functions.returns: Paginated comment threads with author/timestamp/mentions.

functions.name: upsert_change_calendar_policy
functions.description: Create or update a policy/rule controlling change_calendar behavior, with conditions, effects, and a priority.
functions.returns: Policy id, version, and any conflicts with existing policies.

functions.name: list_change_calendar_policies
functions.description: List change_calendar policies/rules with filters and active flags.
functions.returns: Paginated list of policies with priority and last-modified info.

functions.name: link_change_calendar_entities
functions.description: Create a typed relationship between two change_calendar-related entities (parent/child, depends_on, references).
functions.returns: Link id and a graph delta showing newly-created relationships.

functions.name: get_change_calendar_dependency_graph
functions.description: Return the dependency/relationship graph rooted at a change_calendar entity, up to N hops, with cycle detection.
functions.returns: Nodes/edges of the dependency graph and any cycles detected.
